editorial.blurb: Taqueria Los Juanes 2 is a beloved local spot serving authentic Mexican tacos with perfectly seasoned meats, fresh toppings, and genuine hospitality at fair prices.
editorial.insiderTip: Hit Taco Tuesday for $1.50 specials, and arrive just before noon to snag parking before the lunch rush from nearby offices fills the lot.

topDishes.note: tender, perfectly seasoned, and juicy with fresh onion, cilantro, and lime
smoky flavor with a hint of spiciness and crisp toppings
a standout among their impressive meat roster
